svg.title: Levels and links
svg.desc: Four levels, top to bottom. Contradiction: two statements that cannot both be true; no component of Honcho 3.3.0 writes it. Inductive, a pattern, written by the dream's induction agent: 'Anton is highly attentive to dietary restrictions, both his own and those of others', drawn from E5, E19, E10 and E16. Deductive, what follows and updates, written by the dream's deduction agent: the update 'Anton transitioned from a vegetarian diet to a pescatarian diet in June 2026', drawn from E2, E17 and E13, and 'Anton requires a peanut-free restaurant', drawn from E5. Explicit, what was said, written by the deriver as messages arrive: the vegetarian fact E2 (deleted in dream 2), the peanut allergy E5 and again E19, starting to eat fish E17, pescatarian E13, Lena's shellfish E10 and Jonas's coeliac disease E16. Abduction, which Honcho's documentation describes, has no level in the code.
svg.text: Each derived conclusion keeps the ids of the conclusions it was drawn from. The labels E2, D20, … are this figure's; the

Abduction, “inferring the simplest explanations for observed behavior”, is described in Honcho's documentation and has no level or component in
the code. Nothing checks that a conclusion cites only lower levels: in the same run, a pattern cited another pattern.
